inputFields.name: database
inputFields.description: The name of the database where media item exits.

inputFields.name: language
inputFields.description: The language of the media item.

inputFields.name: mediaItemId
inputFields.description: The ID of the media item. If both ID and path parameters are specified, the path parameter is ignored.

inputFields.name: path
inputFields.description: The full path of the media item. If both ID and path parameters are specified, the path parameter is ignored.

inputFields.name: version
inputFields.description: The version number of the media item.
